title: Duodenal biopsy - narrative canned report v4 (flat string fields)

microscopy_text.description: Return PLAIN TEXT (not JSON) for the microscopy section. Write ONE paragraph in natural histopathology report style. Always include villous architecture (default: retained villous architecture) and IEL status (default: not increased). Only mention inflammation/duodenitis if explicitly stated in the input. Mention crypt hyperplasia, gastric/foveolar metaplasia, villous blunting/atrophy, IEL increase only if stated/implied. Always end with: 'There is no dysplasia or malignancy.'

conclusion_text.description: Return PLAIN TEXT (not JSON). MUST ALWAYS be non-empty. Write a short conclusion (1–2 sentences). If coeliac-type features are present, include Marsh classification and advise correlation with anti‑tTG (and clinical context). Marsh mapping: Marsh 0 = retained/normal villi + no increase IEL; Marsh 1 = increased IEL with retained villi; Marsh 2 = increased IEL + crypt hyperplasia with retained villi; Marsh 3a = villous blunting/partial atrophy + increased IEL; Marsh 3b = subtotal villous atrophy + increased IEL; Marsh 3c = total villous atrophy/flat mucosa + increased IEL. If gastric metaplasia and/or duodenitis is present with normal IELs, conclude chronic/peptic-type duodenitis and state no features of coeliac disease. If entirely normal, conclude no features of coeliac disease and within normal limits.

comment_line.description: Optional extra line appended after the conclusion (plain text).
